name: Fuego Agent
summary: Reviewed Fuego task handoff with durable run tracking, progress, cancellation and results.
capabilities: Reads fresh, signed-peer local Fuego Compute connection and admitted-job metadata
Publishes read-only compute status to explicitly permitted Nero Nook plugins
Owns a bundled local view and native window; closing this plugin does not stop compute jobs
Explicit Talk uses a permitted shared local speech provider for microphone recognition and spoken replies. No audio goes to Fuego.
Own isolated human sign-in to Fuego; credentials are never imported from other apps
Sends a reviewed task to your private Fuego agent conversation; existing Fuego context, permissions and budget may apply
Reads run progress and final answers; requests cancellation of that exact run without retrying mutations
Stores up to 20 handoffs privately in plugin-owned local storage
Optional SDK actions list connected targets, prepare a draft for your review, and read one original handoff; draft creation cannot send a job
Optional reviewed workflow wait for an exact existing handoff, with live progress, confirmed remote Stop and a bounded result; no automatic Send or retry
Review Nook module names and notification indicators with a Fuego question; validated replies propose a local opening through normal Nook review
Talk shares words, module names and notification indicators with the selected Fuego agent until Stop. Openings still need Nook confirmation; no replay.
